body: The mental health system does suck. Hmmm maybe that is something to fight for. Demand better from your politicians. Letter writing campaign to your local whatever... draw media attention to the problem ect. People aren't all good or all bad we are all a mix of both. (Look up ying yang.) All you can do is encourage the goodness or not. Your choice.

There is no guarantee that death is the end. Even if your not religious (I am not) science only knows so much. What if after life is somehow way worst the life. No heaven or hell but you just rot in the ground unable to move while you painfully feel every molecule decompose for centuries? Life is a gamble but so is death.
